original_objective: Analyze geographic variation in the human milk microbiome across selected study populations.

original_objective: Identify and quantify associations between environmental and socioeconomic factors and microbiome variation.
current_dataset_support: The supplied MAMI and PRIME files do not contain detailed environmental or socioeconomic variables.
next_action: Retain as an objective but document data limitation; do not fabricate proxies or assign country-level values to individuals.

original_objective: Develop and evaluate AI systems to identify microbiome signatures associated with selected outcomes or population characteristics.
current_dataset_support: Microbiome features support an exploratory study-source classifier and feature association analyses; no feeding or infant outcome labels are present.
next_action: Continue exploratory source/population-characteristic analyses with study-aware validation; do not describe the classifier as feeding or clinical prediction.

original_objective: Assess whether microbiome signatures remain predictive after controlling for geographic location and other confounders.
current_dataset_support: Study/country confounding and missing participant IDs and covariates restrict valid adjusted validation.
next_action: Quantify available confounding, avoid independent country-effect claims, and report limitations; revisit once suitable covariates/IDs are available.
